abstract.para: Learn about &sles4sap; and key benefits of using it for your &sap; workloads.

topic.para: The &sles4sap; 16 subscription combines the capabilities of &sles; and &sleha; with &sap;-specific automation, monitoring and security components. The result is a platform for &sap; applications designed to provide optimized performance, shorten deployment times and reduce planned and unplanned downtime.
&sles4sap; 16 includes all the premium capabilities needed to manage your entire &sap; infrastructure:

listitem.para: &sap; software patterns, &saptune; and &sap;-specific &ansible; roles provide automated deployment and configuration of &sap; workloads.
The &ha; features are designed to keep &hana; databases, &s4h; and other &sap; applications running during &sap; workload, system and environment failures.
Live patching allows systems to run continuously without planned reboots for up to 12 to 13 months while still receiving critical security and stability patches for the kernel and key libraries.
Every minor release is supported for five years, with Long-Term Support (LTS) included in the subscription, making updates more flexible.
